config.title: Systems Coaching — Stylianidou (DBA)
config.description: Repertory-grid study of systems coaching: 35 interviews, six elicited elements each, elicited personal constructs, and four outcome constructs (Challenging, Confident, Aligned, Effective). Read-only worked example. Note: four grids (P6, P11, P13, P17) and some individual constructs were left unrated by participants and carry no ratings.

elicited.left: Personal Uncertainty/not sure what she wants
elicited.right: Certainty of what they want but need to consider what others in the system want

elicited.left: Resolve issue without understanding the system
elicited.right: Understand the system well to achieve results

elicited.left: Low degree of alignment with system
elicited.right: High degree of alignment with systems

elicited.left: Low degree of of influence on the system
elicited.right: High degree of influence on the system
Interaction/unfolding/know where you start but lack of clarity as to the end result
One to many relationships not knowing everyone the same way
Same line of business but different environments

elicited.left: expanded role within the same structure
known understanding of how they fit in the system
elicited.right: Unknown undersatnding of how they fit in the system
Create own strategy and optimise resources

elicited.left: Introcuce the system in coaching space
elicited.right: The coaching space is a system
Very close to systems (systems of systems)

elicited.left: coach may become their system/difficult to keep detachment)

elicited.right: Somatic focus (includes more of the person)

elicited.left: Zoom in to see the details of the view
elicited.right: zoom out to see the wider panoramic view
flow of energy across the system (system connectivity)

elicited.right: expanded boundaries to reveal repeating patterns
